senses.gloss: m. (v. חָלַשׁ, cmp. חֵלֶק) lot, ballot. Pesik. Zakh., p. 22ᵃ (ref. to ויחלש, Ex. XIII, 13) בח׳ לקה וכ׳ Amalek was smitten by ballot (v. חָלַשׁ).
units: Ib. ארבעה שמות נקראו לגורל ח׳ וכ׳ the lot has four names, Ḥêlesh, pûr &c.; Yalk. Ex. 265.—Pl. חֲלָשִׁים, חֲלָשִׁין.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 265:4">Ib.</cite> (quotation) <he>וכאשר יטילו ח׳ על המנות</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 23:2">Sabb. XXIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 148b:19">148ᵇ</cite>) <he>מטילין ח׳ וכ׳</he> lots may be cast for shares of sacred meat &c.
Sabb. 149ᵇ מאי משמע דהאי ח׳ וכ׳ what evidence is there that ḥălashim means lot? (Answ. ref. to Is. XIV, 12).
